You are working in a source checkout of sqlparse (https://github.com/andialbrecht/sqlparse) at an upstream commit. The following problem was reported:

`get_real_name()` returns the wrong component for names with more than two dotted parts: `sqlparse.parse('db.schema.tbl.col')[0].tokens[0].get_real_name()` returns `'schema'` but should return `'col'` (and `get_name()` should also return `'col'`), while `get_parent_name()` remains `'db'`. For `x.y.z AS w` the real name should be `'z'` with alias `'w'`; `mydb.sch.func(1)` should give `'func'`. Two-part names such as `a.b` -> `'b'` already work.

Change the library so the reported behavior is correct. function.name: list_files
function.description: List files under a workspace directory recursively, optionally filtered by a file-name glob.

path.description: Directory relative to the workspace root. Default '.'.

file_glob.description: Optional glob on the relative path or file name, e.g. '*.py'. Default '*'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file with line numbers. Give start_line and end_line to read a region.

function.name: outline
function.description: List the classes and functions of a Python file with line numbers.

function.name: search
function.description: Find lines containing a literal string (plain text, not a regex) in workspace files.

query.description: Required. The literal text to find, e.g. 'def get_real_name'.

path.description: File or directory to search. Default '.'.

file_glob.description: Optional file-name glob selecting which files to search, e.g. '*.py'. It never matches file contents. Default '*'.

function.name: replace_text
function.description: Replace exact text in a file. Fails without changing the file if old_text is absent, or occurs more than once while replace_all is false.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content.

function.name: run
function.description: Run one command in the workspace root without a shell (no pipes or redirection; use forward slashes in paths). 'python' and 'pytest' use the task's Python environment.

function.name: read_output
function.description: Read part of an earlier tool result by its output id (for example out_12). Results that were shown partially say which id and range to request. Give start_line/end_line, or start_byte/end_byte for very long lines.

function.name: search_output
function.description: Find lines containing a literal string (plain text, not a regex) in an earlier tool result by its output id.

query.description: Required. The literal text to find.

function.name: history
function.description: Page through authorized durable session history. The response includes a stable next_cursor.

function.name: search_history
function.description: Find literal text in authorized prior actions and observations without knowing an output ID.

function.name: read_artifact
function.description: Read an authorized session artifact by ID, optionally using an exact byte range.

function.name: note
function.description: Save a named plain-text note that persists across turns. Pinned notes are placed in context when space allows.

function.name: read_note
function.description: Read a saved note by name.

function.name: finish
function.description: Declare the work complete. The final workspace is then checked independently.
